Current Beyblade X meta

Oct 5, 2026–Nov 3, 2026 · 42 tournaments · 113 reported top-cut decks

Results through Oct 26, 2026

Wizard Rod leads reported usage at 59.3% of top-cut decks in this scope. Sieg Superion has the largest increase (5.5 pp). Shark Scale has the largest decrease (9.5 pp).

Most used blades

  1. Wizard Rod59.3% · 67 cuts
  2. Shark Scale54.9% · 62 cuts
  3. Glory Valkyrie22.1% · 25 cuts

What changed

vs. Sep 5, 2026–Oct 4, 2026 · 306 top-cut decks

  • Sieg Superion4.2% → 9.7% usage ↑ 5.5 pp
  • Shark Scale64.4% → 54.9% usage ↓ 9.5 pp

pp = percentage points. At least 10 appearances in either window.
